Booking Process

  1. Find & Reserve
    Browse room availability and submit your booking online.
  2. Check In
    Tap the Check-in button on room booking tablet and enter the 3 digit PIN provided in confirmation email.

PLEASE NOTE: If you do not check-in within the first 15 minutes of your booking, your reservation will be cancelled and the room/pod will become available to other users.
